items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being warned about a growing blind spot in payment scam prevention — staff who process transactions may not see themselves as potential targets, making them more vulnerable to fraud. This human factor is being blamed for rising payment scam losses across Australian organisations. Separately, home battery systems are now flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern in Australia, as internet-connected energy storage devices may expose home networks to security risks.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected request to change payment details — even from a known contact — always verify by phone using a number you already have on file, never one provided in the email or message.
